This will restore RSVP, Bionic Reading, reader, focus, profile, and tutorial preferences to their defaults.
All tuning controls, grouped by section.
Kairo starts in your library. Import a book, open it, then tap the focus word in Reader to jump into RSVP playback.
Use this button to import supported DRM-free files from device storage.
Switch between Books, Saved, and Momentum
Saved collects bookmarks, highlights, and notes. Momentum shows your private, on-device reading profile.
Settings gives you access to RSVP tuning, reader appearance, focus mode, language, support links, and this tutorial.
If you want a different app language, start here. It only affects the interface, not your imported books.
Adjust speed, timing, readability heuristics, typography, and saved RSVP profiles in this section.
Control font size, reader theme, text brightness, and scrolling behavior for the standard reading view.
Focus mode can hide system chrome and optionally pause notifications while you read or use RSVP.
Come back to this row whenever you want the guided tour again. Skipping or finishing it also prevents it from auto-opening next launch.
Use the previous and next buttons here to change pages or chapters. You can also swipe left and right anywhere in the reader to move backward and forward.
Tap the highlighted focus word in the text, or use this play dock, to launch RSVP from your current reading position.
This menu opens search, saved reading, table of contents, focus mode, and Reader-specific settings.
Inside the Reader menu, this section lets you tune font size, theme, text brightness, and scrolling behavior without leaving the book.
Tap the RSVP screen to pause or resume. When playback controls are open, use the center button for play or pause and the side buttons to move backward or forward frame by frame.
When RSVP is paused, this settings button opens quick controls for theme, focus mode, tempo, text size, and the full RSVP tuning panel.
Use gestures directly in the RSVP view. Swipe up or down to change WPM, and swipe left or right to sweep backward or forward through the session.
To leave RSVP, long hold the screen or tap the X in the top-right corner. A long hold should feel like a brief press-and-release, not a drag.
This opens the deeper RSVP settings screen where you can fine-tune timing, typography, profiles, and readability behavior for the playback engine.
